021import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.localization.text.ProxiedLocale;
022import net.kyori.adventure.text.Component;
023import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
024
025import java.util.ArrayList;
026import java.util.LinkedList;
027import java.util.List;
028import java.util.Locale;
029import java.util.concurrent.CompletableFuture;
030
031/**
032 * IShopLayout
033 *
034 * @author creatorfromhell
035 * @since 6.2.0.11
036 */
037public interface IShopLayoutProvider {
038
039  /**
040   * Generates a layout template for the specified shop.
041   *
042   * @param shop the shop instance for which the layout template is to be generated
043   * @return a LinkedList of Strings representing the layout template of the shop
044   */
045  LinkedList<String> layoutTemplate(final Shop shop);
046
047  /**
048   * Creates a snapshot of a shop sign that encapsulates the visual and structural data required
049   * to render the sign, based on the specified shop and locale.
050   *
051   * @param shop the shop instance for which the sign snapshot is to be created
052   * @param locale the locale to be used for formatting and rendering the snapshot
053   * @return a CompletableFuture that completes with a SignRenderSnapshot, representing
054   *         the state of the shop sign
055   */
056  CompletableFuture<SignRenderSnapshot> createSignSnapshot(@NotNull Shop shop, @NotNull final ProxiedLocale locale);
057
058  /**
059   * Renders a snapshot of a shop sign into a list of components based on the provided locale.
060   *
061   * @param snapshot the snapshot representing the current state of the shop sign to be rendered
062   * @param locale the locale to be used for rendering the components
063   * @return a list of components representing the rendered shop sign snapshot
064   */
065  default List<Component> renderSnapshot(final SignRenderSnapshot snapshot, final ProxiedLocale locale) {
066
067    final List<Component> rendered = new ArrayList<>(4);
068
069    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
070      if (snapshot.template().size() <= i || snapshot.template().get(i).isBlank()) {
071        rendered.add(Component.empty());
072        continue;
073      }
074
075      rendered.add(switch (snapshot.template().get(i).toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT)) {
076        case "header" -> renderHeaderSnapshot(snapshot, locale);
077        case "trading" -> renderTradingSnapshot(snapshot, locale);
078        case "item" -> snapshot.itemName();
079        case "price" -> renderPriceSnapshot(snapshot, locale);
080        case "level" -> snapshot.levelLine();
081        default -> Component.empty();
082      });
083    }
084
085    return rendered;
086  }
087
088  /**
089   * Renders the header section of a shop sign snapshot into a component based on the provided locale.
090   *
091   * @param snapshot the snapshot representing the current state of the shop sign's header to be rendered
092   * @param locale the locale to be used for rendering the header component
093   * @return a component representing the rendered header section of the shop sign snapshot
094   */
095  Component renderHeaderSnapshot(final SignRenderSnapshot snapshot, final ProxiedLocale locale);
096
097  /**
098   * Renders the trading section of a shop sign snapshot into a component based on the provided locale.
099   *
100   * @param snapshot the snapshot representing the current state of the shop sign's trading section to be rendered
101   * @param locale the locale to be used for rendering the trading component
102   * @return a component representing the rendered trading section of the shop sign snapshot
103   */
104  Component renderTradingSnapshot(final SignRenderSnapshot snapshot, final ProxiedLocale locale);
105
106  /**
107   * Renders the price section of a shop sign snapshot into a component based on the provided locale.
108   *
109   * @param snapshot the snapshot representing the current state of the shop sign to be rendered
110   * @param locale the locale to be used for rendering the price component
111   * @return a component representing the rendered price section of the shop sign snapshot
112   */
113  Component renderPriceSnapshot(final SignRenderSnapshot snapshot, final ProxiedLocale locale);
114
115  /**
116   * Renders the layout of the specified shop into a list of components based on the provided locale.
117   *
118   * @param shop the shop instance for which the components are to be rendered
119   * @param locale the locale to be used for rendering the components
120   * @return a LinkedList of components representing the visual layout of the shop
121   */
122  LinkedList<Component> render(@NotNull final Shop shop, @NotNull final ProxiedLocale locale);
123
124  /**
125   * Renders the header section of the specified shop into a component.
126   *
127   * @param shop the shop instance for which the header component is to be rendered
128   * @param locale the locale to be used for rendering the header component
129   * @return a component representing the visual header of the shop
130   */
131  Component renderHeader(@NotNull final Shop shop, @NotNull final ProxiedLocale locale);
132
133  /**
134   * Renders the trading section of the specified shop into a component.
135   *
136   * @param shop the shop instance for which the trading component is to be rendered
137   * @param locale the locale to be used for rendering the trading component
138   * @return a component representing the visual trading section of the shop
139   */
140  Component renderTrading(@NotNull final Shop shop, @NotNull final ProxiedLocale locale);
141
142  /**
143   * Renders an item section of the specified shop into a component based on the provided locale.
144   *
145   * @param shop the shop instance for which the item component is to be rendered
146   * @param locale the locale to be used for rendering the item component
147   * @return a component representing the visual item section of the shop
148   */
149  Component renderItem(@NotNull final Shop shop, @NotNull final ProxiedLocale locale);
150
151  /**
152   * Renders the price section of the specified shop into a component based on the provided locale.
153   *
154   * @param shop the shop instance for which the price component is to be rendered
155   * @param locale the locale to be used for rendering the price component
156   * @return a component representing the visual price section of the shop
157   */
158  Component renderPrice(@NotNull final Shop shop, @NotNull final ProxiedLocale locale);
159
160  /**
161   * Renders the enchantment level for books, or the duration for potions into a component based on the provided locale.
162   *
163   * @param shop the shop instance for which the level component is to be rendered
164   * @param locale the locale to be used for rendering the level component
165   * @return a component representing the visual level section of the shop
166   */
167  Component renderLevels(final @NotNull Shop shop, final @NotNull ProxiedLocale locale);
168}
